story.text: The pebbles thrown in at the window turn into little {CAKES}. Alice eats one, and is soon {SMALL} enough to run out of the door, into a thick {WOOD}. There an enormous {PUPPY} is looking down at her with large round {EYES}. She holds out a {STICK}, and it rushes at it, {BARKING} with delight, while she dodges behind a great {THISTLE}.
story.caption: An enormous puppy was looking down at her
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
